doctrine.note: 11 of 19 doctrine gates re-verified in this bundle; the remaining 8 were enforced as a HARD gate at composition (count signed in identity.json.conformance, not re-verifiable offline).

gates.name: No Orphan Nodes
gates.details: Checked 45 nodes for inbound/outbound edges.

gates.name: Bookend & Single XI
gates.details: Verified karta has exactly one ingress + one egress (OctaBox bookend pattern).

gates.name: Schema Compatibility (karta)
gates.details: Checked 83 edges for schema_version compat.

gates.name: Barrier-Sync (karta)
gates.details: Checked 2 multi-source XI join(s) against 2 declared barrier(s).

gates.name: Port Existence (karta)
gates.details: Edge source/target ports must exist on their nodes.

gates.name: Port-Contract Uniqueness (karta)
gates.details: Node ids and (node_id, port_id) contracts must be unique (matches studio_port_contracts_active_uniq).

gates.name: MacroHub Isolation
gates.details: MacroHub nodes must be isolated from the primary chain.

gates.name: MacroHub Standalone
gates.details: A MacroHub (coordinator) node must be a standalone cross-tenant agent, legitimate only in vertical=meta-platform.

gates.name: Cohort k-Anonymity
gates.details: Every MO port must carry anonymization_contract with k_minimum >= 5.

gates.name: Privileged Action Declared + CCAS-Gated
gates.details: Checked 19 privileged action-emitting node(s) against 19 declared privileged_action(s); verified executable ccas_decide() on 19 privileged handler(s) (comment-stripped).

gates.name: Action Selection (typed proposal routes exactly one gate)
gates.details: Checked 19 privileged gate(s) against 1 action_selector(s): each gate reachable only via selector.XO -> gate.XI, selector XO carries the typed ActionProposal.

gates.name: Port Existence
gates.details: Verified an executable port handler def in 274 port files (comment-stripped).

gates.name: Port Independence
gates.details: Static Mi/Mo bleed scan over every DECLARED Xi/Xo handler (a declared port with no file is a violation, not a skip).

gates.name: Anonymization Contract
gates.details: Mo anonymization contract check.

gates.name: Schema Compatibility
gates.details: Checked 83 edges.

gates.name: Barrier-Sync
gates.details: Barrier coordination verified against comment-stripped run_pipeline (2 declared barriers).

gates.name: Macro Hub Compliance
gates.details: No macro_hub in karta.

gates.name: HexaRecord Logging
gates.details: Verified executable log_event() call on the YO return path of 45 YO ports (comment-stripped).

gates.name: HexaSource Provenance
gates.details: Verified executable provenance call in 1 AI-using file (comment-stripped).

gates.name: CCAS Tier Runtime Coverage
gates.details: Verified 4/4 declared tier(s) (auto, manual, human, dual_approval) are handled in executable ccas_gate.py code (comment-stripped: 4 canonical branch(es), 8 alias map entr(ies)).

gates.name: Runtime Join Parity
gates.details: Runtime join parity verified for 2 declared barriers.

gates.name: Strict Contract E2E
gates.details: Strict payload+envelope enforcement verified across 45 XO-emitting nodes: static wiring in the emitted runtime PLUS an emitted runtime proof that a contract violation actually RAISES (self-derived subject, runs in the suite and in CI where the flag is pinned). Proves ENFORCEMENT COMPLETENESS (declared contracts are enforced end-to-end at runtime) — not semantic maturity of the contract contents; see ARTIFACT_CONTRACT_COMPLETENESS for the declared-form measurement, and ARTIFACT_MO_CONTRACT_E2E for the cohort-boundary (MO) proof.

gates.name: Contract Completeness (measurement)
gates.details: Contract completeness (measurement, never blocking): 274 contracts — 67 with empty properties, 115 without required, 1 with additionalProperties:false, 0 with hard constraints. Leniency is DECLARED policy (blocker2): payload sub-schemas stay lenient by design; enforcement of what IS declared is proven by ARTIFACT_STRICT_CONTRACT_E2E.

gates.name: MO Contract E2E (cohort boundary)
gates.details: MO cohort-boundary contract proven end-to-end on 1 MO-fed egress node (contract-driven release, fail-closed model validation, under-k hold, metadata containment, distinct-tenant k, emitted runtime proofs); 1 inactive MO port verified honest (relay-shaped contract + retained k-floor AC) (L7/L8).

gates.name: Audit Binding E2E (who / exact input / exact output)
gates.details: Audit chain binds WHO/WHAT-IN/WHAT-OUT in the HASHED core: principal established at the transport boundary (zt_guard -> set_principal, explicit "auth_disabled" in dev), 110 _record_audit sites bind exact input+output, canonical_sha256 is the single recomputable canonicalisation, and emitted unit+e2e proofs verify tamper-evidence (L7/L8).

gates.name: Training Pack E2E (SLM enablement chain)
gates.details: SLM enablement chain proven on 24/24 training pack(s): complete spec/corpus/eval per model-bound node, LIVE output_schema reference to the node's own contract, a harness that truly enforces acceptance criterion 1 (required+types, fail-closed), and emitted runtime proofs (L7/L8).

gates.name: Single Guarded Entrypoint (no unauthenticated route surface)
gates.details: One guarded app: build_app() returns runtime/api_server.py (every route Depends(zt_guard); only /healthz open), src/main.py + runtime.serve + Dockerfile CMD converge on it, no raw per-node router is served, and the emitted runtime test proves every served route rejects an unauthenticated caller (P0 auth-bypass closed by construction — L7/L8).

gates.name: Bundle Manifest Signed (every delivered file hash-bound to the signed identity)
gates.details: Every delivered file (except the structurally-post-signature exclusions listed SIGNED in conformance.manifest.excluded) is hashed into MANIFEST.json, whose canonical hash is Ed25519-signed in identity.conformance.manifest. verify_identity.py recomputes the manifest hash + every file sha256 and sweeps the disk BEFORE any bundle code runs; the PY twin + emitted pytest re-verify on the complete artifact (supply-chain integrity — a code change that breaks no test is now caught cryptographically, L7/L8).

gates.name: Admin Surface Guarded (loopback default, fail-closed mutations, no wildcard CORS, not default-started)
gates.details: The generated admin server binds loopback by default, emits no wildcard CORS, and fail-closes every mutating endpoint behind ADMIN_API_TOKEN; docker-compose does not start it by default (profile) and binds only 127.0.0.1 — no unauthenticated mutable control surface in the default package (external DD, L7/L8).

gates.name: CCAS Approval Provenance (structured, action-bound, signed, fail-closed — no bare-name approvals)
gates.details: CCAS is a tier-enforcement interface + fail-closed approval seam: a bare name counts for nothing; an approval must be a structured record bound to THIS action, carry an approver role, use a fresh nonce, be unexpired (expires_at is signature-bound — stripping it breaks the signature), be NOT-YET-CONSUMED in the persistent ledger (Fas 2.17: an approval that released an action once can never release another — consumption is recorded BEFORE approval is returned, fail-closed on an unavailable ledger), and be signature-verified against the customer approval backend (CCAS_APPROVAL_KEY, a CUSTOMER_SLOT — fail-closed when unbound). Independence de-dupes on approver principal (external DD, L7/L8).

gates.name: Config/Runtime Parity (env knobs are read; single-replica default for process-local state)
gates.details: Generated config/deploy artifacts match runtime: BARRIER_TIMEOUT_MS is read from the environment with a default equal to .env.example (no inert knob), and the k8s manifest defaults to a single replica because the state is process-local — scaling >1 requires binding external state (external DD, L8).

gates.name: Supply Chain Pinned (Actions on commit SHAs, no unpinned pip installs, Dependabot present)
gates.details: Build supply chain is pinned: every GitHub Action uses: is a 40-hex commit SHA, no unpinned pip installs ship in the Dockerfile/workflows, and Dependabot keeps the pins current (external DD #5, 2.14a). The hashed transitive lock, full SBOM, and base-image digest are measured in CI (2.14b).

gates.name: Supply Chain Measured (transitive hash-locked lock + CycloneDX SBOM measured before export and signed; base-image digest two-state)
gates.details: [SUPPLY_CHAIN_MEASURED_AND_LOCKED] The transitive hash-locked requirements + full CycloneDX SBOM are MEASURED BY THE FACTORY (bundle-invariant deps) and BORN IN this bundle as signed files (hashed into the Ed25519 manifest) — measured before export, not by a post-delivery CI bootstrap; the lock's drift marker binds it to the emitted pyproject. The base image is digest-pinned, BORN IN SIGNED (MEASURED_AND_LOCKED) — Dockerfile, compose and build-image all consume the measured ref. Nothing is written post-signing (verify-only workflow re-proves fail-closed: --require-hashes install of the full closure + pip check + SBOM coverage + drift marker). External DD, 2.18/2.19, L8.

gates.name: Reference Capability E2E (opt-in factory harness runs the full happy path through the action gate; approval provenance never relaxed)
gates.details: The factory-controlled reference capability ships end-to-end: an explicit opt-in harness (DOER_REFERENCE_MODE, default OFF, every output marked "reference") gives contract-derived outputs for unimplemented CUSTOMER_SLOTs and a side-effect-free reference execution AFTER ccas approval; approval material (request_id + SIGNED approvals) flows with the action request and 2.13c provenance is never relaxed; the emitted e2e proof covers fail-closed default, held ungated actions, and the full signed-approval happy path through the action gate with a verified audit chain (external DD #7, 2.16, L7/L8).

gates.name: Image Provenance Bound (built image carries the signed bundle identity as labels; pushed digest Sigstore-attested by the emitted build chain)
gates.details: The emitted build chain WIRES the image<->bundle binding (OCI labels resolved from the SIGNED files, pushed digest Sigstore-attested, verification doc shipped) and that wiring is re-verifiable. But the trust BOOTSTRAP is NOT externally anchored: the build workflow runs the in-checkout verifier (verify_identity.py) and reads MANIFEST.json from the same mutable checkout, so a party who controls the checkout can tamper the source, neutralise the in-checkout verifier and update its hash in the local manifest — the in-CI precheck would still pass and the image would be labelled bound. The binding is therefore tamper-EVIDENT, not externally anchored, and this control is N/A until an external trust anchor is configured: pin verification to a SHA-pinned cross-repo reusable workflow AND supply the HexaBox root fingerprint out-of-band (secret HEXABOX_ROOT_FINGERPRINT), not from the checkout (docs/verify_root_fingerprint.md). It does NOT PASS on the presence of the wiring alone.

artifact_conformance_blurb: Artifact conformance — proves the generated code implements what the karta declared. Re-runnable anywhere. Not a doctrine gate.

gates.name: Generated Test ↔ Schema Parity
gates.details: Verified generated smoke payloads + contract requires-tests against per-node schemas.json (XI smoke parity + 8-port contract parity, comment-free).

gates.name: Cross-Module Import Integrity
gates.details: Every `from src.shared.<mod> import <symbol>` must resolve to a symbol actually defined in that module.

gates.name: Signed Sample Event Accepted
gates.details: The signed input_model sample_event satisfies the generated ingress envelope rules (source present; no blank envelope fields) — input model, demo and runtime cannot drift apart.

build_integrity_blurb: Factory QA — proves the generator emitted sound code. Not part of the doctrine score.
